understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete the KA59 puzzle game by solving each level: position every selectable piece onto the goal tile(s) marked '+' in the semantic grid, with all goals occupied simultaneously to trigger WIN, then proceed until the final level is won within the per-level step budget.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn controlled one currently selected piece (shown as P in the semantic grid and via player.position/player.id). MOVE actions attempted to shift that piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) in the chosen direction; walls/boundaries and adjacent objects could block or alter movement, and the movement.*_blocked flag was only a hint (an adjacent object) rather than a guarantee. Some objects (blocks) could be pushable: if immediately adjacent in the move direction, the selected piece could push them so both would shift, unless blocked by a wall/other obstruction. Levels could contain multiple selectables; CLICK with an exact object pixel position switched control to the selectable at that position (changing which piece moves).
